_comment: Data/Progress/progress.json - the ONE progress record this server keeps. There are no accounts: each clone of this repo is run by one person, so there is nothing to identify and nothing to authenticate.

resume._comment: Where the app sends you back to on your next visit. null until you have opened anything.

progress._comment: Keyed 'w<week>d<day>'. A part completes when viewed; a day completes when all of its parts have. attempted_problems records practice problems you have run code against.
